question: Is the full-cycle QH rank-1 result a genuine distinct cycle mechanism, or does it arise because QI bias has opposite signed accumulation across physically distinct rising/falling water-table blocks?

geometry_regime_definition.source: immutable BC2-A2 projected H(t), independent of C3 bias response

channel_ledger.source_definition: identical elementary/family contribution ledger as C3

comparator.monotonic_reference: Use already-persisted C3 WT_RISE and WT_FALL family rank for the same width and numerical route.
comparator.response_use: C3 monotonic rankings are comparator evidence, not used to alter block boundaries or metrics.

decision_rule.DIRECTION_PARTITION_EXPLAINS_CYCLE_RANK_: For both widths and both numerical routes, every CYCLE rising block rank-1 family equals that width/route's C3 WT_RISE rank-1 family, every CYCLE falling block rank-1 family equals the C3 WT_FALL rank-1 family, and primary/cross rank-1 agrees for each block.
decision_rule.WITHIN_DIRECTION_REGIME_DEPENDENCE_REMAI: All hard gates pass but at least one CYCLE block does not match its corresponding monotonic-direction rank-1 family or has a primary/cross rank-1 mismatch.
decision_rule.NUMERICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Any block cannot be reconstructed, leaves the qualified domain, or violates the C3 conservation/identity gates.

interpretation_constraints: This diagnostic tests cancellation and direction partition only; it is not a direction-switched model.
A positive direction-partition result may authorize a later teacher-forced oracle counterfactual panel, but not a production switch.
Because qH directly changes total unsaturated storage while qi redistributes bulk-to-terminal water, both channels must remain separately reported even when one is rank-1 for shape.
No threshold based on C3 bias magnitude is introduced.
next_step_if_direction_explains: Preregister a teacher-forced causal oracle-removal panel within the fixed Hdot-sign regimes, testing QI-only, QH-only and QI+QH removal before proposing any implementable closure.
next_step_if_not: Retain finer history/phase dependence and do not introduce a direction-only correction.
